anomalies.detail: quantised types under 1% of the data section — each still needs its own dequant
blk.13.ffn_gate.weight is IQ1_M (type id 29) at 1.75 bits/weight — the only tensor at this width
GSQ-RCO is mixed precision by design: every quantised role spans several types. A per-role kernel therefore needs every type in its range, not one.
types that occur in exactly one layer of a role: a kernel path serving one layer is the worst kind of specialisation to carry

a GDN block's state-op tensors are split across precisions — BF16: ssm_alpha, ssm_beta; F32: ssm_a, ssm_conv1d, ssm_dt, ssm_norm. A single fused GDN kernel has to take both an F32 path and a BF16 path for vectors of the same block, and the quantised projections in the same layer are a third path.
token_embd is IQ2_S (2.5625 bpw) but output is Q4_K (4.5 bpw), same shape — untied, two different dequant paths on the largest matrices
